title: My Sister In Law Forged A Deed And Sold My Paid Off Home For $350K. So I Voided The Sale
description: After 31 years as a hospital housekeeper, I paid off my $225,000 bungalow, only to learn my sister-in-law forged a transfer-on-death deed and sold it for $350,000 while I was in rehab. She mailed me a $4,700 caregiver stipend check, but I discovered the notary stamp belonged to a woman dead for two years. Now I run Threshold of Deceit Respite Care from my reclaimed home while she scrubs guest towels in a smock that says Deeded Me Out. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #DeedFraud
thumb_text: SHE SOLD MY PAID OFF HOME. I VOIDED IT
pinned_comment: If you got a $4,700 caregiver stipend check from a sister-in-law who just sold your paid-off bungalow for $350,000 while you were in rehab, what would you have done? Tell me your version in the comments, I read every single one.
